p0_corrections_applied: P0.1: Canonical control registry generated from controls.py (corrects prior report errors on titles, weights, legal refs)
P0.2: NOT_APPLICABLE scoring fixed — pillar renormalization, 'Not Scorable' edge case, scoring_version bumped to 1.1
P0.3: Citation grounding fixed — silent chunks[0] substitution removed, ambiguity detection fixed (list-per-key section map)
P0.4: LLM failure path fixed — RAG-grounded controls return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on failure, not deterministic PASS

compliance_framework.statute: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act 2023)

control_weights.note: Control weights are 1.0, 1.5, or 2.0 — NOT 0.6–1.0 as incorrectly stated in prior report

trust_score_engine.formula_type: Deterministic Hierarchical Weighted Aggregation with Renormalization
trust_score_engine.denominator_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE controls excluded from per-pillar denominator
trust_score_engine.pillar_na_rule: If ALL controls in a pillar are NOT_APPLICABLE, that pillar is excluded from global aggregation and remaining pillar weights are renormalized
trust_score_engine.all_na_rule: If ALL pillars are NOT_APPLICABLE, trust_score=0.0 (placeholder), posture='Not Scorable', all_not_applicable=True
trust_score_engine.missing_eval_rule: Missing TIEResult entries are treated as UNKNOWN (weight 0.3), NOT as NOT_APPLICABLE
trust_score_engine.rounding_rule: Intermediate pillar scores NOT rounded before aggregation; final trust_score rounded to 1 decimal place

p02_correction_notes.old_behavior: Pillar with all-NA controls contributed 0.0 * pillar_weight to total, causing undercount
p02_correction_notes.new_behavior: Fully-NA pillars are excluded; remaining pillar weights renormalized; score correctly reflects only evaluated pillars
p02_correction_notes.impact_on_api: pillar_scores now includes is_not_applicable field; TrustScoreResult includes all_not_applicable field; scoring_version bumped to 1.1

rag_knowledge_base.primary_document: The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
rag_knowledge_base.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, Government of India
rag_knowledge_base.gazette_reference: CG-DL-E-12082023-247997, Gazette of India Extraordinary, Part II, Section 1, dated 2023-08-11
rag_knowledge_base.similarity_metric: Cosine Similarity (Inner Product on L2-normalized vectors)

citation_grounding.policy: P0.3: Citations accepted ONLY when chunk_id or section unambiguously resolves to a retrieved chunk
citation_grounding.rejected_behavior: Unresolvable citations are logged and rejected; recorded in TIEResult.error field
citation_grounding.ambiguity_detection: Multiple chunks sharing same section key = ambiguous = rejected
citation_grounding.excerpt_verification: Model-provided excerpt verified as substring of chunk text; replaced with chunk text if not verified

llm_failure_policy.rag_grounded_controls: Return INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE on any failure (RAG unavailable, Groq failure, invalid JSON, empty response)
llm_failure_policy.no_false_compliance: Scanner signal presence alone cannot produce PASS for qualitative controls

website_scanner.score_separation: Scanner score represents technical transport/web signal; isolated from compliance Trust Score

historical_test_evidence.note: Test results from prior verification (2026-10-07) remain valid for unchanged components
